kind: Controlled tactical puzzles; other players rest unless the scenario states active responses

tests.name: planner follows a supplied flank around a defended central barrier over several owner turns
planner completes a nearby goal instead of collecting an unrelated nearly ready airport
planner develops a useful airport, holds it, and actually disrupts the remote scoring route
planner repairs a severed goal route and retains real supply through following turns
planner reassesses after an active opponent legally cuts the committed route, then reconnects and finishes
planner stops an imminent enemy connection before the opponent attempts its finishing deployment
planner breaks an obstructing pact and then exploits the opening with legal paid actions
planner accepts a useful public truce that prevents an immediate supply cut and then completes its route
planner is deterministic and reads no opponent hand, deck order, or raw private fields
only accepted actions commit private memory; observations isolate it and reset clears all plans
malformed planner metadata cannot inject unbounded paths, hidden fields, scores, or another player intent
seeded planner replay preserves actions, rules state, bounded memory, and finite search through changing positions
an irrelevant distant public stone does not discard an ongoing useful commitment
planner integration preserves released rules, seeded layouts, deck draws, scoring, and shared action results
